description: This Java class 'WeightPackageSessionLine' models a shipment weight package line with properties such as order ID, package dimensions, weight, shipment box type, and sequence ID. It includes methods for accessing and modifying these properties and a method to apply the line to a shipment package using a dispatcher.

classes.name: WeightPackageSessionLine
classes.description: A serializable Java class representing a line item in a shipment weight package, with properties for dimensions, weight, shipment identifiers, and methods to manipulate and apply the line.

methods.name: WeightPackageSessionLine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the package line with order ID, weight, dimensions, shipment box type, and sequence ID.

methods.name: applyLineToPackage
